signal_hypotheses.feature: Average excess return of watch-list clean liftoffs relative to sector
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compute mean 10-day excess return for watch-list liftoffs and compare to sector mean
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Watch-list picks should outperform sector average
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: If watch-list picks do not outperform sector average, the watch list adds no value.
